'''''Cerastium holosteoides''''', the '''common mouse-ear chickweed''', is a species of flowering plant belonging to the family [[Caryophyllaceae]].<ref name="POWO152312-1">{{cite web |title=''Cerastium holosteoides'' Fr. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:152312-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=15 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

Its native range is [[temperate]] and [[subarctic]] areas of the Old World; scattered countries in Africa, nearly all of Eurasia to New Guinea. One of the world's most widespread weeds, it has been introduced to most of North America, the western countries of South America, New Zealand, South Africa, and many islands around the world.<ref name="POWO152312-1" />
